headline: A weekend on the water.
sub: Find small waterfront stays and easy walks along the coast.
rows: A two-room inn above a quiet cove.
A short walk from the village quay.
Wind-shaped pines and a long view.
look: Airy travel editorial with sea-grey framing, periwinkle and rounded photo slots.
prompt: Build a coastal inn directory in Coastal Editorial. Use my waterfront photography and make each stay easy to compare.

headline: Drawings that hold up on site.
sub: Architectural detailing and fabrication coordination for small public buildings.
look: Monochrome architectural presentation with specimen-like structure and aligned data.
prompt: Use Blueprint Mono for a fabrication studio portfolio. Make the drawings and their specifications the focus.

headline: What kept projects on schedule.
sub: A quarterly field report on approvals, lead times, and delivery across three sample sites.
rows: One review moved to next quarter
look: Report cover and findings spread with a marigold metric block and print-like rules.
prompt: Lay out my quarterly delivery report in Marigold Report. Use gold for section and metric blocks, and keep tables print-friendly.

headline: Rooms made for slower mornings.
sub: Three materials lead the palette for a small seaside residence.
rows: Warm grain for furniture and window seats.
Soft reflection on walls that catch afternoon light.
An unlined curtain for diffuse light.
look: Oat and coffee tones, poster-scale type, and material-led art direction for a studio.
prompt: Use Atelier Warm for an interior concept deck. Pair my oak, plaster and linen reference photos with a short note on each material.

headline: Furniture for smaller rooms.
sub: Compact oak pieces with dimensions and care information up front.
rows: Solid oak with a clear matte finish.
A narrow footprint for tight corners.
look: Warm retail palette, terracotta actions, lifted product cards and a dark collection band.
prompt: Build a compact furniture storefront in Terracotta Commerce. Use my lifestyle photos and show the dimensions beside each product.

headline: The Vector S: built to drive.
sub: A lightweight concept coupe with a naturally aspirated engine and a manual gearbox.
rows: Aluminium structure with a low seating position.
Simple instruments angled toward the driver.
look: Luxury showroom with a near-black stage, amber accents and uppercase display type.
prompt: Build a car showcase in Midnight Showroom. Stage my cut-out vehicle images on black and keep specifications in a separate section.

headline: Stories from below the surface.
sub: A short series about the people who work on rivers, harbors and canals.
rows: Keeping an old canal moving through a dry summer.
A day in the life of a harbor pilot.
What flood markers tell the people who live nearby.
The crews who keep crossings running.
look: Daylight media index with a black program band, platform links and an episode shelf.
prompt: Use Broadcast Light for a podcast hub. Give each episode its own thumbnail, duration, and listening link.

headline: From rough idea to first release.
sub: A design studio that tests ideas in short, hands-on sprints.
rows: Agree on the task and what success looks like.
Watch people use it and decide what to change.
look: Monochrome agency page using a grid, pill actions and staggered process cards.
prompt: Design our agency process page in Studio Kinetic. Use the team photos I provide and show how a sprint progresses.

headline: Learn by making the first thing.
sub: Short, hands-on courses in photography, publishing and print.
rows: Fold, bind and publish a short edition.
Sequence eight frames into a narrative.
look: High-contrast course catalogue with yellow actions and alternating light and dark bands.
prompt: Build a workshop catalogue in Campus Bright. Give every course a thumbnail and make duration and skill level easy to scan.

headline: Plan a direct charter.
sub: Compare aircraft and seating before requesting a route review.
look: Corporate aviation layout with navy framing, white content cards and a restrained red rule.
prompt: Design a private charter planner in Charter Navy. Use navy for actions and red only for small marks. Show how seat count differs by aircraft.

headline: Get a van across town.
sub: See sample pickup windows and choose the right service for your load.
rows: High-roof van with a second handler.
look: Safety-yellow service page with black type, flat panels and a checkered dispatch stripe.
prompt: Build a same-day van booking page in Dispatch Yellow. Put pickup windows and load limits before the quote action.
